outline: 分子生物學為現代生物科技尤其是基因工程的基礎學問。課程內容深入探討生物的四大類分子：DNA及RNA，蛋白質，脂質，以及醣類分子。並且詳細探討現代分子生物學之中心思想，包含DNA 複製、轉錄、轉譯等。
schedule:
Week 1 Genes: introduce
Week 2 cells and organisms
Week 3 Basic geneics
Week 4 DNA, RNA and Proteins
Week 5 Genomes and DNA
注意: 3/19補課2節 (補4/2 and4/9 週二各一節)
3/26補課2節 (補4/24 請假)
Week 6 Manipulation of nucleic acids,
Week 7 4/3 週三第1次評量，由助教代理協助監考
Week 8 cloning genes for analysis
Week 9 PCR
Week 10 (已於3/26補課) DNA sequencing
Week 11 Gneomics and system biology
Week 12 第2次評量 cell division and cell replication
Week 13 transcription of genes
Week 14 processing of RNA
Week 15 Protein synthesis
Week 16 第3次評量 protein structure and function
note: 第17、18週實施線上教學
Week 17 regulation of transcription (線上教學)
Week 18Overview of the advanced molecular biology(線上教學)
